**Body**:

Phase 05 (/codify) for the Ollama provider track. Extracts three
process learnings from rounds 14-16 into reusable artifacts.

Updated agents (2):
- advisory-safety-chain-specialist.md — rewrote the chain to reflect
  the autonomous Delegate + 5-clause Refusal Policy (T121/T122).
  Removed stale references to deleted regex guardrails.
- shadow-agent-specialist.md — added C1 adapter-injection invariants
  and the round 15 regression lesson (grep ALL consumers via
  rg "DelegateConfig\(" before declaring a refactor complete)

New rules (2):
- rules/abstraction-consumers.md — when modifying a shared abstraction,
  enumerate ALL consumers via grep before declaring complete. The plan's
  named files are a starting point, not the full list. Codifies the
  round 15 shadow.py C1 regression.
- rules/upstream-patches.md — when a runtime monkey-patch for an
  upstream SDK bug is acceptable: 4 conditions (upstream issue filed,
  isolated, regression-tested, reversible). Codifies the M4 kaizen-
  agents lesson from round 16.

Updated rules (1):
- rules/testing.md — new "Multi-Turn Protocol Testing" section.
  For LLM-touching PRs, require at least one live integration test
  that does a real multi-turn round-trip through real infrastructure.
  Codifies the round 16 lesson: 1165 green unit tests while the entire
  Ollama tool path was broken at the wire level.

New skill (1):
- skills/project/ollama-byok-provider.md — comprehensive BYOK Ollama
  knowledge: tool-capable allowlist, per-request adapter injection,
  1024-dim embeddings, M4 runtime patch lifecycle, qwen3/qwq model
  guidance, debugging checklist, cross-reference to all 9 upstream issues

Updated skills (2):
- skills/project/advisory-safety-chain.md — rewrote chain steps table,
  added 5-clause Refusal Policy reference, documented what was
  deleted/kept in T121/T122, fixed stale /advisory/stream endpoint path
- skills/project/SKILL.md — was a 3-line stale placeholder, now a
  proper index of 18 project skills grouped by domain with paired-agent
  routing table

New E2E test (1):
- apps/web/tests/e2e/10-production-smoke.spec.ts — Playwright test
  against deployed https://arbor.terrene.foundation; verifies health,
  HTML, login affordance, security headers, HTTP→HTTPS redirect.
  5/5 passed in 2.5s against v0.4.0.

Artifacts updated locally. This is a downstream project repo — changes
stay local. Only BUILD repos (kailash-py, kailash-rs) create upstream
proposals.
